Frequently asked questions

How quickly can a plumber reach me in Leeds?

Within two hours for emergencies, anywhere inside the Leeds ring road, and our measured average in 2025 was 94 minutes. Outside the ring road we quote a time when you call. Planned work is booked within five working days.

How much does an emergency call-out cost?

£95 including VAT for the first hour, day or night, weekday or weekend. Parts are charged at trade cost plus 15% and you see the list before anything is fitted. There is no extra charge for evenings or bank holidays.

What should I do while I wait for the engineer?

Turn off the stopcock, usually under the kitchen sink, then open the cold taps to drain the pipes. Switch off the boiler at the wall if water is near it. Move furniture and electrical items away from the leak and put a bucket under any drip.

Which boiler brands do you repair?

Worcester Bosch, Vaillant, Ideal, Baxi, Viessmann, Glow-worm and Potterton. Our vans carry common parts for the first five, so most repairs finish on the first visit. For other brands we order parts and return within two working days.

Are your engineers Gas Safe registered?

Yes. Every engineer is on the Gas Safe Register under company number 512345 and carries an ID card you can check on the register website before letting them in. We re-verify every card each January.

Do you charge more at weekends?

No. The call-out fee and hourly rate are the same seven days a week, including bank holidays. The only thing that changes at weekends is that boiler servicing is not offered, because those slots are reserved for emergencies.
